subScenes.name: 破冰寒暄
subScenes.description: 初见时轻松打招呼，评论咖啡馆环境，打破沉默。

qaPairs.triggerText: How did you end up here tonight?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你今晚是怎么来这儿的？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会破冰寒暄：询问对方如何到达约会地点

followUps.text: I took the subway — it’s faster than driving this time of night.
followUps.text_cn: 我坐地铁来的，这个时间开车还不如地铁快。

followUps.text: A friend dropped me off — I’m not great with parking around here.
followUps.text_cn: 朋友送我来的，我对这儿的停车太头疼了。

followUps.text: I live just around the corner — walked here in 10 minutes.
followUps.text_cn: 我就住附近，走十分钟就到了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于约会初期破冰，自然引出个人生活细节，避免只答‘我开车来的’这种单薄回应

qaPairs.triggerText: So, what do you usually do on weekends?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 那你平时周末一般做什么？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会破冰寒暄：询问对方日常休闲习惯

followUps.text: I’m big on hiking — last weekend I hit the trails up at Blue Ridge.
followUps.text_cn: 我超爱徒步，上周末去了蓝岭步道。

followUps.text: Honestly? I’m mostly a couch potato — binge-watching shows and ordering takeout.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话？我就是个沙发土豆，追剧+点外卖。

followUps.text: I try to mix it up — sometimes coffee shops, sometimes art galleries, sometimes just napping.
followUps.text_cn: 我尽量多样化：有时去咖啡馆，有时看画展，有时就只是睡觉。

qaPairs.usageNote: 避免只说‘我休息’或‘我待在家’，应提供具体行为或偏好，让对话有延展性

qaPairs.triggerText: What made you want to come on this date?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 是什么让你决定来这次约会的？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会破冰寒暄：温和探询对方的动机，建立情感连接

followUps.text: Your profile just felt real — not too polished, like you actually live your life.
followUps.text_cn: 你的个人资料感觉很真实，不是那种过度包装的，像是真正在生活的人。

followUps.text: I was curious — we have so many mutual friends, I figured we might actually click.
followUps.text_cn: 我很好奇，我们有这么多共同朋友，我觉得我们说不定挺合得来。

followUps.text: To be honest? I was a little nervous, but I’m glad I came — you seem easy to talk to.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话？我有点紧张，但很高兴来了——你说话让人很放松。

qaPairs.usageNote: 此问题敏感但常见，回答需平衡真诚与得体，避免过度奉承或冷漠敷衍

subScenes.name: 寻找共鸣
subScenes.description: 通过开放式问题探讨兴趣爱好，发现共同话题。

qaPairs.triggerText: I've been into hiking ever since I moved to the mountains last year. Do you ever get out into nature?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 自从去年搬到山里，我就爱上了徒步。你平时会去大自然里走走吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会中通过分享个人爱好试探共同兴趣，寻找情感共鸣

followUps.text: Actually, I love hiking too! Last month I hiked Mount Rainier — the view was insane.
followUps.text_cn: 我其实也超爱徒步！上个月我爬了雷尼尔山，景色太震撼了。

followUps.text: I haven't done much hiking, but I'd love to try it — any trails you'd recommend?
followUps.text_cn: 我徒步不多，但很想试试！你有推荐的路线吗？

followUps.text: I'm more of a city person, but I totally get why you love it — sounds peaceful.
followUps.text_cn: 我更喜欢城市生活，但我完全理解你为什么爱这个，听起来很宁静。

qaPairs.usageNote: 当对方分享个人爱好时，回应应体现共鸣、开放或尊重，避免简单否定。此对话模式常用于约会初期建立情感连接。

qaPairs.triggerText: I binge-watch old sitcoms every weekend. Like Friends or The Office. You got any shows you can't stop watching?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我每个周末都追老情景喜剧，比如《老友记》或《办公室》。你有没有停不下来的剧？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 通过流行文化话题试探共同喜好，建立轻松共鸣

followUps.text: Oh my gosh, I rewatch The Office every time I'm stressed — Jim and Pam are my comfort couple!
followUps.text_cn: 天啊，我每次压力大都会重看《办公室》，吉姆和潘是我治愈系CP！

followUps.text: I haven't seen those, but I'm into Korean dramas — maybe we could swap recommendations?
followUps.text_cn: 我没看过这些，但我超爱韩剧，要不要互相推荐一下？

followUps.text: I mostly just scroll TikTok on weekends… but I’ve heard The Office is hilarious!
followUps.text_cn: 我周末 mostly 刷TikTok… 但听说《办公室》超好笑！

qaPairs.usageNote: 在约会中，用流行文化作为切入点非常高效。回应时避免只说‘我没看过’，而应加入态度或开放邀请，维持对话温度。

qaPairs.triggerText: I’m a total coffee addict — I go to that little café on 5th every morning. Do you have a go-to spot?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我是个咖啡成瘾者，每天早上都去第五街那家小咖啡馆。你有固定去的地方吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 通过日常习惯寻找生活节奏的共鸣，为未来邀约埋下伏笔

followUps.text: Yes! That’s my spot too — I always get the oat milk latte by the window.
followUps.text_cn: 是啊！那就是我的地盘——我总坐在窗边点燕麦拿铁。

followUps.text: I usually drink tea at home, but I’d love to try your café sometime — is it busy on weekends?
followUps.text_cn: 我一般在家喝茶，但真想哪天去你常去的那家试试——周末人多吗？

followUps.text: I’m more of a home-brew guy… but I love how coffee shops feel like little community hubs.
followUps.text_cn: 我更喜欢自己煮咖啡… 但我超爱咖啡馆那种社区氛围。

qaPairs.usageNote: 日常习惯是建立亲密感的隐形桥梁。回应时，即使习惯不同，也应肯定对方生活方式的情感意义，避免评判。

subScenes.name: 表达兴趣
subScenes.description: 自然回应对方分享，用赞美和追问表达真诚关注。

qaPairs.triggerText: I really enjoyed our conversation tonight — what do you like to do for fun outside of work?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我真的很喜欢今晚的聊天——你下班后平时喜欢做什么放松？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会中表达兴趣并询问对方兴趣爱好

followUps.text: I love hiking on weekends — there’s a great trail just outside the city.
followUps.text_cn: 我喜欢周末去徒步——城外有一条特别棒的步道。

followUps.text: Honestly, I’m more of a homebody — I binge-watch shows and cook new recipes.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话我更宅一点——喜欢追剧和尝试新菜谱。

followUps.text: I’ve been wanting to try pottery classes — have you ever done anything like that?
followUps.text_cn: 我最近想试试陶艺课——你做过类似的事情吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于回应对方对个人兴趣的开放式提问，展示真实个性同时为后续互动铺路

qaPairs.triggerText: You seem really passionate about travel — where’s the one place you’d go back to in a heartbeat?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你对旅行好像特别有热情——有没有一个地方是你想立刻再回去的？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 对方因你的表达而进一步聚焦旅行话题，试探情感共鸣

followUps.text: Kyoto — the temples, the tea houses, the silence… I felt completely at peace there.
followUps.text_cn: 京都——寺庙、茶屋、宁静的氛围……我在那里感到完全放松。

followUps.text: I’d love to go back to Bali, but I’m saving up for a trip to Iceland next year.
followUps.text_cn: 我很想再回巴厘岛，但我正在存钱明年去冰岛。

followUps.text: Actually, I’ve never been abroad — I’m kind of nervous about traveling far.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我从来没出过国——对远行还有点紧张。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应对方对旅行经历的深入提问，可展现情感深度、现实考量或自我暴露，增强约会亲密度

qaPairs.triggerText: I’ve been thinking… would you be open to grabbing coffee next weekend?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我一直在想……你愿意下周末一起喝杯咖啡吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 对方直接发出邀约，需回应是否接受或提出条件

followUps.text: Yes, I’d love that! Saturday afternoon works for me.
followUps.text_cn: 当然好啊！周六下午我有空。

followUps.text: I’m free on Sunday, but Saturday’s already booked — how about that?
followUps.text_cn: 周六我已经有安排了，周日有空——那天怎么样？

followUps.text: I’m not sure yet — I’ve got a lot on my plate this month. Can I get back to you by Thursday?
followUps.text_cn: 我现在还不确定——这个月事情有点多。我周四前回复你行吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 应对约会中关键的邀约时刻，回应需体现真诚、礼貌与边界感，避免机械式答应或冷淡拒绝

subScenes.name: 邀约下一次
subScenes.description: 礼貌提出下次见面建议，结合共同兴趣自然收尾。

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like to grab coffee next week?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 下周一起去喝杯咖啡吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会后邀约下一次见面

followUps.text: That sounds great! How about Wednesday afternoon?
followUps.text_cn: 太好了！周三下午怎么样？

followUps.text: I'm pretty busy next week, but maybe the week after?
followUps.text_cn: 下周我挺忙的，但后周可以吗？

followUps.text: I'd love to, but let me check my schedule and get back to you?
followUps.text_cn: 我很想，但我得先查一下日程，再回复你？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于约会后自然延续关系，回应对方邀约时需体现真诚与边界感

qaPairs.triggerText: Want to try that new Italian place this weekend?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 这周末去试试那家新意大利餐厅吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 基于共同兴趣的下一次邀约（餐饮）

followUps.text: Yes! I’ve been dying to try it — Saturday night works for me.
followUps.text_cn: 当然！我早就想去了——周六晚上我有空。

followUps.text: I’m not really into Italian food, but maybe something else?
followUps.text_cn: 我对意大利菜不太感兴趣，不过我们可以换别的？

followUps.text: I’m not sure — I’ve got a family thing Saturday, but Sunday’s open.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，周六有家事，但周日有空。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应饮食邀约时，避免直接拒绝，用‘换别的’或‘改时间’维持关系温度

qaPairs.triggerText: How about we catch a movie next time?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 下次一起看电影怎么样？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 模糊邀约下一次（未定具体时间）

followUps.text: I’d love that! I’ve been meaning to see the new Marvel movie.
followUps.text_cn: 太好了！我正想看那部新漫威电影呢。

followUps.text: Movies aren’t really my thing, but I’m up for something else.
followUps.text_cn: 电影不是我的最爱，但我愿意做点别的。

followUps.text: Maybe — I’m kind of tired after work, but let’s keep it on the list?
followUps.text_cn: 也许吧，下班后我挺累的，不过先记着？

qaPairs.usageNote: 当邀约较模糊时，回应需平衡礼貌与真实意愿，避免冷场或过度承诺

subScenes.name: 得体告别
subScenes.description: 表达愉快时光，微笑道别，留下良好印象。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 约会结束时，对方提出再次见面的邀请

followUps.text: I'd love to! Let me know what works for you.
followUps.text_cn: 我很想！告诉我你什么时候有空。

followUps.text: I had a great time, but I think we're better as friends.
followUps.text_cn: 我玩得很开心，但我觉得我们更适合做朋友。

followUps.text: Maybe—let me check my schedule next week and get back to you.
followUps.text_cn: 也许吧，我下周查一下日程再告诉你。

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是约会结束时最经典的告别试探句，回应需体现态度但避免生硬。

qaPairs.triggerText: It was really nice meeting you tonight.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 今晚认识你真的很开心。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 对方以温和方式表达好感，暗示可能继续联系

followUps.text: Same here! I’ve been looking forward to this all week.
followUps.text_cn: 我也是！我这周都在期待这次见面。

followUps.text: Thanks, I had a good time too—hope you have a great night!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢，我也玩得很开心，祝你今晚愉快！

followUps.text: Yeah, it was fun… I’m just not sure I’m ready for something serious yet.
followUps.text_cn: 嗯，挺有趣的……但我还不确定自己准备好进入一段认真的关系了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 这句话常作为告别前的情感铺垫，回应需匹配自身真实意图，避免虚假热情。

qaPairs.triggerText: I should probably head out now.
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 对方主动提出结束约会，观察你是否愿意挽留或提议再约

followUps.text: Can I walk you to the subway? Maybe we can grab coffee next time?
followUps.text_cn: 我送你到地铁站吧？下次我们可以一起去喝咖啡？

followUps.text: Of course, thanks for tonight. Take care!
followUps.text_cn: 当然，谢谢今晚的陪伴，保重！

followUps.text: Wait—do you mind if I text you tomorrow? I want to tell you about that movie we talked about.
followUps.text_cn: 等一下——我明天发你消息可以吗？我想跟你聊聊我们刚才说的那部电影。

qaPairs.usageNote: 当对方说‘该走了’时，你的回应决定关系走向，需自然带出态度，避免沉默或过度热情。
